sentences.text: When your fix doesn’t match your dead reckoning position, the difference is current, along with any wind effect or steering error.
The set is the direction from the DR position to the fix at the same time.
The drift is the distance between them divided by the hours since your last fix.
Notice the direction: always from the DR toward the fix.
Measuring from the fix back to the DR gives the reciprocal, exactly one hundred eighty degrees wrong, and that wrong answer is almost always one of the choices.
